children: On August 26, 2026, the company received a notice from Nasdaq that it is not in compliance with Listing Rule 5250(c)(1) for failing to timely file its Form 10-Q for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. There is no immediate impact on its Nasdaq listing; the company has 60 days (until October 26, 2026) to submit a compliance plan, and if accepted, may have until February 22, 2027 to regain compliance. The company plans to file the Form 10-Q in September 2026.
